snippet.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault | Developer Update
snippet.description:
💚Play #Moonlighter 2 now in Early Access: https://re.11bits.com/33c

Hear from Javi Gimenes - CEO and Co-Founder of @DigitalSunGames sharing a heartfelt update on Early Access to Moonlighter 2. 

Whether you’re exploring Tresna, mastering the vault, or running your shop - thanks for being part of the adventure 🫶

The road ahead is packed with updates shaped directly by player feedback - all building toward the full release, planned for 2026.
